MongoDB is part of 7 of my public repositories, from 2012 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (3), [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2), [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (1) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (1).

Most recently: [docks](@/work/docks.md): Repository containing useful Dockerfile(s); [gooddata\_connectors\_metadata](@/work/gooddata-connectors-metadata.md): The gem for accessing metadata for gooddata connector infrastructure; [lethe.it](@/work/lethe-it.md): lethe.it - your personal smart links archive, organizer, classifier and much more.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses MongoDB: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links MongoDB to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
